body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Clipcomm presented its super slim stereo headset ‘HCS-100’ during CES 2008.

Supporting Bluetooth 2.0, it enables you to enjoy music stored in PC or mobile devices like mp3 player, PMP and laptop wirelessly. It features long battery life of 15-hour talk and 550-hour standby time.
